description: Source code for the Warehouse plugin implementation in the WPEFramework, including initialization, deinitialization, and notification handling.

classes.name: Warehouse
classes.description: Implementation of the Warehouse plugin, managing initialization, shutdown, and remote connection notifications.

methods.name: Warehouse
methods.description: Constructor, initializes internal members and logs startup.

methods.name: Warehouse::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service, sets up notifications and warehouse interface.

methods.name: Warehouse::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, releases warehouse interface, and terminates remote connection.

methods.name: Warehouse::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string (currently empty).

methods.name: Warehouse::Deactivated
methods.description: Handles remote connection deactivation events, triggers plugin deactivation process.
